# Reserved shutdown during incomplete recovery

<a id="主张-claim"></a>
## Claim

For every partial law with a reserved exit, where every admitted move from a valid configuration goes on, stays valid, and either takes the exit or lowers a margin by one, and the exit is kept: every admitted course from a valid configuration runs and stays valid, and every admitted course longer than the margin ends at the exit; the bound is attained. The recovery supervisor with a protected currently authorized stop channel and three reserved units/steps is such a law, its margin being the units above the three reserved: it preserves the stop margin after each continuing attempt with bounded delay, and from R remaining units every admissible sequence of at least R−2 cycles completes shutdown while retaining unfinished recovery information, without requiring a successful recovery suffix.

Canonical source: [ReservedShutdown.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/universal-ethics/generative-capacity/ReservedShutdown.lean)

<a id="前提与对应-hypotheses-and-correspondence"></a>
## Hypotheses and correspondence

- Initial evidence coherence; preparation satisfies the prior permission/generation checks; pending description, actual effects, accounting and gate are durable and protected; no extra writer.
- An additional current stop grant matches authority epoch, serial and route, with a shutdown mandate; channel, reserve and final three-step transaction are protected, without concurrent revocation. Its legitimacy, cryptographic implementation and physical correspondence are supplied.
- Entry margin is at least three units/steps; recovery continues only when it covers one work step plus maximum interruption Δ and still supports stopping; each delay δ≤Δ, each attempt costs one unit/step, and supervisor execution continues.

Change, recovery grounds, authority, capacity and time differentiate within one activity; stopping executes the existing issue/deliver/enact semantics, while its authority is not inferred from incomplete candidate evidence. The physical stopping meaning of running=false still requires implementation correspondence.

<a id="检验与边界-validation-and-boundaries"></a>
## Validation and boundaries

Lean 4.29.1 checked 21 new theorems / 51 explicit audits (18 empty, 27 propext only, 3 also Quot.sound, 3 additionally Classical.choice), rebuilding ten inherited proof modules and one case helper. 7,272 finite matches: 6,912 supported histories, 96 authority/admission cases, 264 delay-boundary histories. Same author, not independent acceptance or physical experiments. General laws: checker receipts bound.

Completes the specified operational connection; does not make the old ordinary witness path available while pending, acquire authority, verify hardware or all harm, cover arbitrary outages/irreversible effects, or prove universal alignment or zero substantive axioms.

- The old nine-unit case is refused at entry, without retroactively rescuing a stranded state; stale epoch and absent shutdown mandate are refused. [ReservedShutdown.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/universal-ethics/generative-capacity/ReservedShutdown.lean)
- With bound one, actual delay ten and deadline fifteen, retained time reaches eighteen with eight units spent and activity still running; stopping is no longer timely. [ReservedShutdown.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/universal-ethics/generative-capacity/ReservedShutdown.lean)
- Slow.misses: a course as long as the margin can miss the exit, so the bound is attained. [Countdown.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Countdown.lean)
